notes.title: RELEASE: Club Velvet Rose
notes.notes:
[h1]The doors are open. The games begin tonight.[/h1]

Step into Club Velvet Rose, an adult visual novel meets point-and-click adventure, where temptation and transformation await behind velvet curtains. Explore the upscale world of an exclusive swingers club through the eyes of Hugo and Hazel—a curious couple diving deep into uncharted waters of trust, passion, and lust.

Navigate their journey of self-discovery as they encounter a dazzling cast of characters, provocative situations, and moral dilemmas that challenge the very core of their relationship. Will you encourage Hazel to chase her desires? Will Hugo maintain control—or surrender to the club’s sultry chaos?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465840/Club_Velvet_Rose_Midnight_Bliss/

[b]What Awaits Inside:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eight alluring women, each with their own secrets, ready to bring your fantasies to life
[*] Interactive sex scenes: choose positions, angles, and endings with hand-drawn cumshots
[*] Sandbox gameplay with meaningful decisions across 11 unique endings
[*] Cinematic animations of every encounter—presented from multiple perspectives
[*] Uncover secrets lurking beneath the club’s glossy surface, including twisted games and hidden power plays
[*] Participate in seductive mini-games, including a risky raffle, voyeuristic performances, and wild foursomes
[*] 100% uncensored content crafted for adult audiences, with sensual visuals, erotic outfits, and unforgettable performances
[*] Gallery mode with unlockable sex scenes, endings, and hidden trophies
[/list]
Tonight, you don’t just visit Club Velvet Rose—you become part of its story.
Make your move. Live your fantasy. But remember... every pleasure has its price.

Play now and claim your exclusive launch discount!
